title: ?author= filter is case-insensitive beyond spec

title: Validation trims whitespace and bounds year 0..=9999 beyond spec

title: Mutex lock uses .unwrap(), panics on poisoning
evidence: src/lib.rs:141,155,178,190,198 `db.lock().unwrap()` — a panic in any handler poisons the mutex and crashes all subsequent requests
suggestion: Map the PoisonError to ApiError::Internal instead of unwrapping

title: Single global Mutex<Connection> serializes all DB access
evidence: src/lib.rs:12 `Db = Arc<Mutex<Connection>>` — every request contends on one lock; fine for the task, limits concurrency
suggestion: None for this task; a connection pool (r2d2) would scale better
